features.feature: True open passage and pale support
features.interpretation_and_limits: Real through-air path under upper volume preserved. No dark-photo region filled as a wall. Mesh ray checks verify the intended opening.

Long straight flight is on outer gallery edge, rises toward far terminal platform. Representative 22 treads are not a measured count. Underside filled to display base for robustness, not a structural as-built claim.

features.feature: Sculpted roof, oval opening, slits and fins
features.interpretation_and_limits: Variable-height curved roof and irregular edges, oval aperture and two long slit recesses, tapered/projecting blades. Exact slope fields, slit depths, curvature, fins and terrace edge levels are proportional, not measured. Deep dark closure below roof opening is an exterior-only interior abstraction. The tall low-Y end is set back behind a lower rim; a distinct main-roof road-flank terrace has inboard-rising steps and a separate lower shoulder. These are separate from the gallery terminal stair; step counts and levels remain representative.
Grey to grey-green aggregate, darker lower walls, dark metal/glass, pale warm buff soffits and neutral terrace. No photographic texture, broad terracotta panels, or exact calibrated colours.
